[[SK Rapid Wien|Rapid Wien II]] (4) | prevseason = [[2025–26 Austrian Football Second League|2025–26]] | nextseason = [[2027–28 Austrian Football Second League|2027–28]] | updated = 20 September 2026 }} The '''2026–27 Austrian Football Second League''', also known as the '''Admiral 2nd League''' for sponsorship purposes, is the 53rd season of the [[Austria]]n second-level [[Association football|football]] league and the ninth as the Second League. The league consists of 16 teams. ==Teams== Sixteen teams are participating in the 2026–27 season. [[FC Blau-Weiß Linz]] was relegated from the Bundesliga in [[2025–26 Austrian Football Bundesliga|2025–26]] season, replacing last year's 2nd League champion [[SC Austria Lustenau]]. Moving up from the lower divisions are [[ASK Voitsberg]], promoted from the [[Austrian Regionalliga Central]] and [[FC Wacker Innsbruck (2002)|Wacker Innsbruck]], promoted from the [[Austrian Regionalliga West]]. No team was promoted from the [[Austrian Regionalliga East]]. ASK Voitsberg, Blau-Weiß Linz and Wacker Innsbruck return to the second tier after one, four and five years absence, respectively. [[SK Austria Klagenfurt (2007)|Austria Klagenfurt]] were relegated to the third tier following an insolvency application and multiple financial violations.{{cite web|url=https://www.vienna.at/football-bundesliga-wiener-austria-and-rapid-wien-receive-license-for-2026-27-in-first-instance/10097675|title=Football Bundesliga: Wiener Austria and Rapid Wien Receive License for 2026/27 in First Instance|website=vienna.at|access-date=1 September 2026}} {{Location map+|Austria|float=right|width=425|caption=Location of teams in the '''2026–27 Austrian Football Second League'''|places= {{Location map~|Austria|lat=48.1167|long=14.867|label=[[SKU Amstetten|Amstetten]]|position=bottom}} {{Location map~|Austria|lat=48.101021|long=16.284250|label=[[Admira Wacker|Admira]]|position=bottom}} {{Location map~|Austria|lat=47.504170|long=9.734860|label=[[Schwarz-Weiß Bregenz|Bregenz]]|position=top}} {{Location map~|Austria|lat=48.249444|long=16.357778|label=[[Floridsdorfer AC|FAC]]
